# omnibias

Reusable derivative primitives for Physics-Informed Neural Networks.

Read only what the task needs:
- AGENTS.md: repository contracts and checks.
- docs/pinn.md: residuals, boundary losses and parameter training.
- docs/derivatives.md: directional and multivariate jets; torch/JAX usage.
- docs/guarantees.md: numerical and performance limits.
- docs/packages.md: the 16 primitive distributions and API entry pages.

Consumer products live in sibling repositories under ../omnibias_projects/.
Start a PINN application in ../omnibias_projects/omnibias-pinn/.
